steps.content: Under the sand wall, Korryn leisurely watches the far-off drama.

The well-prepared desert bandits clearly hold the upper hand. Most of the security team's main force is diverted to capture the remnants of Tuco, weakening the sand ship's defenses. Though their firepower is stronger than the desert bandits, they can't fend off their ambushes.
Korryn watches intently, but a resentful voice suddenly comes from her side.

steps.speaker: Security Team Member
steps.content: Do you think the desert bandits will spare Tuco? Don't be foolish. If you go help us now, you might still be able to save your skins...

steps.speaker: Security Team Member
steps.content: We are an official DisCity team. If you want to survive, you'd better hurry and cooperate with the security team...

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: I know.

steps.speaker: Security Team Member
steps.content: Huh?
Korryn brushes off the white sand from the brim of her hat, revealing a half-mocking, half-pitying smile.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: You silly boy. They're bandits. Do you really think they'd give up such a fat sheep?
On the sand ship, the desert bandits have already reached the deck. They're about to break into the cockpit and take control of the entire ship.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Member
steps.content: Damn, feels great! Hypercubes and weapons... we scored big this time!

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Member
steps.content: Boss?
The desert bandit leader looks at the figure standing in the distance under the sand wall, his eyes gleaming.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
steps.content: Heh... a bunch of old and sickly fools, only meant for the worms.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
steps.content: Screw their "unfortunate souls" crap... They don't know what's survival of the fittest? I thought that Sinner woman would be useful, but they're all idiots. Might as well take them all out!
A burst of gunfire takes down the guards by the cockpit door. He's just one step away from fully controlling the sand ship.
That's right, just reach out and push the door. The "treasure" is right at the doorstep...
Suddenly, a strong wind gushes in from behind. The desert bandit ducks, narrowly avoiding the steel pipe that slammed down where he was standing.
Whoa, you dodged pretty fast.
I'd say this pipe isn't as good as the original.
A petite figure makes a dazzling entrance with the alarm blaring. She stands above, looking down on everyone.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
steps.content: What the... it's you?! Weren't you locked in the...?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Cage? I've fought countless Corruptors, taken down three Black Rings, knocked some sense into that dummy ${PlayerName}, and even broke out of the MBCC. You think your crappy cage can restrain me?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: The tables have turned. Now it's my turn... Hands up, this is a stick-up! Hand over all your treasures!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hmph! This is the price you pay for underestimating the great Hella!
